recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless the display extension is reintroduced into core or the extension-pack definition regresses from the resolved name/title and canonical URL values.
issue_request: FHIR-37557 was a Published FHIR-core change request for the R4 display extension. The reporter suggested changing id/url as well as name/title, but the final Persuasive with Modification resolution was to change name to DisplayName, add title Display Name, and leave id and url unchanged for inter-version compatibility.
initial_application: Core commit 06b1575fe5ad2babe3fee7bb9b856428dd51bdb2 applied the issue by changing the display extension row in source/profiles/general-extensions-spreadsheet.xml from name Display Name with no title to name DisplayName and title Display Name while keeping the row id as display.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2022-06-13 approved the narrowed name/title change, and the June 2022 Zulip thread specifically warned not to change the existing canonical URL. Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed extension definitions from the R5 source tree. The current core general-extensions spreadsheet no longer contains a display extension row; the authoritative definition now appears in the FHIR Extension Pack.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current core checkout has no display extension definition to edit, and /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/datatypes/StructureDefinition-display.xml already matches the Jira resolution with id display, url http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/display, name DisplayName, and title Display Name.
